## Results

| Gene | UniProt | Length | Molecular weight |
|------|---------|--------|------------------|
| **ELL2** | O00472 (ELL2_HUMAN) | 640 aa | **72.32 kDa** |
| **AHCYL2** | Q96HN2 (SAHH3_HUMAN) | 611 aa | **66.72 kDa** |

ELL2 (72.32 kDa) is heavier than AHCYL2 (66.72 kDa) by ~5.6 kDa.

Notes on method: masses were computed from the canonical reviewed UniProt sequences using BioPython `ProteinAnalysis.molecular_weight()` (average residue masses, unmodified polypeptide). ELL2's computed mass (72,323.5 Da) matches the UniProt-listed mass (72,324 Da) exactly, validating the approach. The UniProt mass field for AHCYL2 returned a corrupted value (9,000,000,000 Da), so that entry's mass was taken from the sequence calculation instead; 611 aa × ~109 Da/aa ≈ 66.7 kDa is consistent.
